subject.title: [Feature]: Pattern-based channel allowlist for Discord (glob/wildcard support)

question: Should Discord guild channel admission support name patterns, and if so what syntax and precedence should apply relative to exact channel, thread-parent, category, and literal `*` matches?
rationale: This adds a new authorization-sensitive configuration contract; repository policy does not determine whether patterns should be implicit channel-map keys, an explicit typed map, or rejected in favor of category admission.

options.title: Add explicit patterns map
options.body: Introduce a typed Discord pattern map with documented deterministic precedence while preserving exact keys and literal `*` semantics.

options.title: Prefer category admission
options.body: Use Discord category IDs as the supported dynamic grouping mechanism and decline name-based globs.

options.title: Keep exact allowlists
options.body: Retain exact channel entries and literal `*`, addressing restart latency only through the separate reload work.

recommendation.title: Add explicit patterns map
recommendation.body: Introduce a typed Discord pattern map with documented deterministic precedence while preserving exact keys and literal `*` semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared matcher and recent Discord authorization-path history make steipete the strongest available routing candidate for the precedence decision.
